import json,os,signal,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/Users/chazu/dev/zig/birnam');pid=84695
control=root/'docs/measurements/74w-loop-production-process-control.json'
expected_command='/Users/chazu/.local/bin/rk daemon run'
def inspect():
 p=subprocess.run(['ps','-ww','-p',str(pid),'-o','lstart=,command='],capture_output=True,text=True)
 return p.stdout.strip() if p.returncode==0 else None
original=inspect()
assert original and original.endswith(expected_command),original
assert original.startswith('Sun Sep 13 01:30:48 2026'),original
state=subprocess.check_output(['ps','-p',str(pid),'-o','state='],text=True).strip()
assert 'T' not in state,'rk was already stopped; do not take ownership of its pause'
r=dict(status='running',pid=pid,identity=original,paused=False,resumed=False,started=time.time(),scope='User-authorized SIGSTOP/SIGCONT of the verified rk daemon only. Existing compiler children receive no signals. Existing host gates remain unchanged. Finally resumes the same daemon on completion, failure, timeout or handled interruption.')
def save():control.write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
def interrupted(signum,frame):raise KeyboardInterrupt(f'signal {signum}')
for signum in (signal.SIGINT,signal.SIGTERM):signal.signal(signum,interrupted)
child=None
try:
 assert inspect()==original
 os.kill(pid,signal.SIGSTOP);r['paused']=True;r['paused_at']=time.time();save()
 print('Paused verified rk daemon',pid,original,flush=True)
 command=['python3','scripts/loop-production-timing.py','--prefix','/var/folders/f3/n4drgs5d7f3f6zxxxd2snx6m0000gn/T/birnam-loop-timing-kbg1gnea/prefix','--receipt','docs/measurements/74w-loop-cost-production-correctness.json','--verified','docs/measurements/74w-loop-production-driver-correctness.json','--output','docs/measurements/74w-loop-production-paused-timing.json']
 assert not (root/command[-1]).exists(),'refusing to overwrite timing evidence'
 with Path('/tmp/birnam-74w-production-loop-paused-timing.log').open('w') as log:
  child=subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=root,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
  r['measurement_pid']=child.pid;save()
  r['exit_code']=child.wait(timeout=3600)
 r['status']='finished'
except BaseException as error:
 r.update(status='failed',error=str(error))
 raise
finally:
 if child is not None and child.poll() is None:
  child.terminate()
  try:child.wait(timeout=10)
  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:child.kill();child.wait()
 if r['paused']:
  if inspect()==original:
   os.kill(pid,signal.SIGCONT)
   r['resumed']=True;r['resumed_at']=time.time()
   r['state_after_resume']=subprocess.run(['ps','-p',str(pid),'-o','state='],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
   print('Resumed same rk daemon',pid,flush=True)
  else:r['resume_note']='Original process is no longer present; no signal sent to a changed PID'
 r['finished']=time.time();save()
